items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: When Sidney got back here, I'm the man, picked Sidney and his manager up at the airport in my car. And I had a layout for him that night up at the house with him and his manager. I gave him a party that night.

ctx.x: I was going to ask about Sidney Bechet, if you heard him when you were a boy, he wasn't much older.

Sidney brought up right by my house all these days. About the same age as you? He's just a few years older than me. He must have been around about four years older than me. But Sidney left here, when Sidney left here, and he didn't get back here in twenty some odd years. When Sidney got back here, I'm the man, picked Sidney and his manager up at the airport in my car. And I had a layout for him that night up at the house with him and his manager. I gave him a party that night.
In the late years he played the soprano sax more than he did clarinet. Than he did clarinet. Did he play clarinet mostly here or the other?
